summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Members management functionality in Marsol Dashboard. All backend member endpoints working perfectly (100% success rate). Frontend Members page fully functional with complete CRUD operations, search, filtering, and Excel export. Full integration between frontend and backend confirmed working.

POST /api/members creates new member successfully
PUT /api/members/{id} updates member data correctly
DELETE /api/members/{id} removes member successfully
GET /api/members/{id} retrieves single member data
GET /api/members/options/all returns all filter options (sectors, packages, curators, business_sizes, projects)
Members page loads correctly with proper Azerbaijani interface
Members table displays with all required columns (Şirkət, Sektor, Paket, Kurator, Rəhbər, Əlaqədar, Email, Əməliyyat)
Add Member button opens modal with complete form
Member creation form accepts all required fields (company_name, sector, package, curator, business_size, director info, contact info, email)
Dropdown selections work for all form fields (sector, package, business size, curator)
Member creation successfully saves to backend and displays in table
Search functionality filters members by company name, director, or contact person
Filter panel opens and closes correctly
Filter options populate from backend /api/members/options/all endpoint
Excel export button triggers CSV download with proper UTF-8 encoding
Member table shows proper badges for package types and business sizes
Authentication integration works - protected routes require valid token
Frontend correctly uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL environment variable
All UI elements have proper data-testid attributes for testing
Complete member workflow: Create → Display → Search → Filter → Export
